scope.purpose: Targeted successor subgraph used to diagnose and re-run the affected dependency cone before any integration into the full L graph.

forbidden_inference: No source-domain word is used as a semantic category or quotient key.
No historical PD-* category or B-* candidate basis ID is used.
No W track or synthesis evidence is used.
No familiar mathematical definition is imported.

provenance.source_span: explicit finite bases for C, C', H, H', O, O'
provenance.load_bearing_note: Exposes the finite source basis rather than leaving the family name opaque.

provenance.source_reversible_reference: L05 §2 multiplication tables (1) and source-local table instances
provenance.source_span: complete source basis multiplication table for each coefficient family
provenance.load_bearing_note: The table is raw finite source data. General product behavior beyond table rows is not inferred here.

provenance.source_span: KAPPA(e0)=e0 and KAPPA(ei)=-ei for i>0
provenance.load_bearing_note: Exact basis action of source conjugation.

provenance.source_span: KAPPA(xy)=KAPPA(y)KAPPA(x) and KAPPA^2=id
provenance.load_bearing_note: Load-bearing anti-involution behavior stated by the source.

provenance.source_span: source diagonal composition metric for each coefficient family
provenance.load_bearing_note: Raw source pairings distinguish ordinary and split signatures.

provenance.source_span: split signatures are kept distinct from positive-definite division-algebra cases
provenance.load_bearing_note: Preserves the source distinction without turning the family names into primitive classes.

provenance.source_span: basis tables and scalar/vector operations determine products on represented coefficient carriers
provenance.load_bearing_note: This is the first explicit reopened boundary: finite source tables are present, but the generic scalar/vector/bilinear extension behavior must be represented rather than assumed.

provenance.source_span: V, Q_minus, and Q_plus are distinct source role carriers of the same represented real dimension
provenance.load_bearing_note: Keeps roles distinct while exposing their shared finite basis size.

provenance.source_span: v_a -> e_a
provenance.load_bearing_note: Exact basis-level source map.

provenance.source_span: m_a -> e_a
provenance.load_bearing_note: Exact basis-level source map.

provenance.source_span: p_a -> KAPPA(e_a)
provenance.load_bearing_note: The source tilde/conjugation convention is inside the map.

provenance.source_span: the three basis maps extend as exact linear bijections into the coefficient carrier
provenance.load_bearing_note: Basis incidence is explicit; generic finite-vector and linear-extension behavior must be represented before this may close.

provenance.source_span: T(x,y,z)=B(z,x*y)
provenance.load_bearing_note: Exposes exact ordered product/pairing incidence.

provenance.source_span: coefficient-level T is transported to distinct V/Q_minus/Q_plus roles through the source coefficient maps
provenance.load_bearing_note: Requires exact map/linear transport rather than raw coefficient swapping.

provenance.source_span: typed T(v,psi,chi)=T(psi,chi,v)=T(chi,v,psi) with the source role transports
provenance.load_bearing_note: Preserves cyclicity at the typed-role level.

provenance.source_span: a coefficient h is recovered from the scalar functional z |-> T(x,y,z) through equality of all pairings B(z,h)
provenance.load_bearing_note: Source states recovery; exact generic nondegenerate-recovery behavior remains a lower-schema question.

provenance.source_span: the recovery graph is identified with the source product graph
provenance.load_bearing_note: Structural bidirectionality is load-bearing, not merely notation.

provenance.source_span: ordinary-O typed cyclicity has source-table failures while the other represented source cases pass the finite checks
provenance.load_bearing_note: Negative control only; no source repair is imported.

provenance.source_span: s_u=+1 -> phase=1; s_u=-1 -> phase=i; Q(u)=s_u
provenance.load_bearing_note: Exposes the source branch rather than opaque sqrt(s_u).

provenance.source_span: v -> -s_u u KAPPA(v) u; chi -> sqrt(s_u) KAPPA(u) tilde(chi); psi -> sqrt(s_u) KAPPA(psi) KAPPA(u)
provenance.load_bearing_note: Ordered products are preserved; no associativity rewrite.

provenance.source_span: chi -> sqrt(s_u) tilde(chi) KAPPA(u); psi -> -s_u u KAPPA(psi) u; v -> sqrt(s_u) KAPPA(u) KAPPA(v)
provenance.load_bearing_note: Ordered products are preserved; no associativity rewrite.

provenance.source_span: psi -> sqrt(s_u) KAPPA(u) KAPPA(psi); v -> sqrt(s_u) KAPPA(v) KAPPA(u); chi -> -s_u u tilde(chi) u
provenance.load_bearing_note: Ordered products are preserved; no associativity rewrite.

provenance.source_span: each generalized reflection places outputs in the corresponding complexified role carriers; space-like outputs lie in the embedded real subspace while time-like branches carry the source phase i
provenance.load_bearing_note: Does not identify complexified roles with a later real form.

provenance.source_span: T(R_v v,R_v chi,R_v psi)=-T(v,chi,psi)
provenance.load_bearing_note: Source anti-invariance with typed role ordering.

provenance.source_span: T(R_m chi,R_m psi,R_m v)=-T(chi,psi,v)
provenance.load_bearing_note: Source anti-invariance with source cyclic role ordering.

provenance.source_span: T(R_p psi,R_p v,R_p chi)=-T(psi,v,chi)
provenance.load_bearing_note: Source anti-invariance with source cyclic role ordering.

provenance.source_span: two/even generalized-reflection compositions preserve the triality form T
provenance.load_bearing_note: Target parity-of-composition behavior; derivation versus direct source assertion remains explicit.

provenance.source_span: ordinary-O source-table inconsistency propagates where it affects reflection tests and is not repaired
provenance.load_bearing_note: Adversarial control only.
